Clause-②: yes (widening)
Responsibility: `packages/spec` `FieldSchema.returnType` (`number | text | boolean | date`) | none: nothing refuses; a formula over money is stored and rendered as a bare number | every app with a formula over currency fields (measured on HotCRM, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2058, finding B-15)
Thread-read: none
Prior rulings read: `formula returnType`, `currency`, `returnType` → ADR-0032 §3 and ADR-0035 §3 (currency only as a formatter or derivation term, not this question); #19677's pull-back (`form-return-type-options.test.ts` header): "a pull-back, not a decision about what a formula may return". Nothing rules on this widening.
Serial constraints cleared: the file lists of all 11 open PRs, read in this act. None touches `field.zod.ts` or `packages/formula`. #22713 touches `object.form.ts`, which is out of this surface. The `field.zod.ts` edge is "one key addition at a time": none is open.
